relationships.description: Azure Container Apps serves Enhanced HEAT ITSM as the ITSM platform will migrate to serverless compute
AI Support Chatbot accesses Enhanced HEAT ITSM for ticket creation and status queries
Self-Service Portal serves Consolidated Global Helpdesk by reducing ticket volume
Proactive Cost Monitoring serves Azure Container Apps by tracking container resource usage and costs

inserts.rationale: Serverless compute platform aligns with cost reduction goals
Modernized ITSM platform improves support efficiency

updates.rationale: Legacy ITSM platform being replaced by Enhanced HEAT ITSM

exploration.gap_analysis: Authentication capability is currently underserved with outdated password-only methods. File management in Japan relies on legacy on-prem servers, which need modernization.
exploration.sunset_risks: HEAT ITSM is being retired but has a clear replacement in Enhanced HEAT ITSM. On-prem file servers in Japan are critical for low-latency Excel editing and require a hybrid solution.
exploration.maturity_trends: Azure Cloud Infrastructure and Support Services domains show significant improvement with serverless adoption and ITSM modernization.
exploration.overlaps: Dual region architecture in Azure creates unnecessary redundancy, which will be addressed by consolidating to a single SEA region.

recommendations: Prioritize Azure Container Apps pilot to validate serverless cost savings.
Accelerate Enhanced HEAT ITSM deployment to improve support efficiency.
Implement Windows Hello to address authentication gaps and improve security.
Deploy Azure File Sync in Japan to retire on-prem file servers while maintaining low-latency access.
